context: Complete password-strength validation, verification-code countdown and four actual ASCII character-class hints. Named level/time preserved. A–Z/a–z/0–9 remain explicit in every script; accented/non-Latin letters are never falsely promised to satisfy these classes. Personal singular, including Frisian/Welsh/Balkan prompts. No policy or strength algorithm changes.
